# opencode-append-system

An OpenCode plugin that appends a Markdown instruction file to the system prompt for each chat request.

## Installation

```sh
npm install opencode-append-system
```

Add the package to `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["opencode-append-system"]
}
```

Restart OpenCode after changing the configuration.

## Instruction files

The plugin searches from the current project directory up to the worktree root for:

```text
.opencode/APPEND_SYSTEM.md
```

The first project file found is used. If no project file exists, the plugin reads `APPEND_SYSTEM.md` from the global OpenCode configuration directory. Set `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` to use a custom global configuration directory; otherwise the default is `~/.config/opencode`.

A UTF-8 BOM is removed, and files containing only whitespace are ignored. Project files that resolve outside the worktree are rejected.

## Local development

```sh
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```
